title: Automatic classification of prostate cancer Gleason scores from multiparametric magnetic resonance images

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《Automatic classification of prostate cancer Gleason scores from multiparametric magnetic resonance images》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-1】Noninvasive, radiological image-based detection and stratification of Gleason patterns can impact clinical outcomes, treatment selection, and the determination of disease status at diagnosis without subjecting patients to surgical biopsies.

sections.title: 主要结果
sections.text:
《Automatic classification of prostate cancer Gleason scores from multiparametric magnetic resonance images》：结果的原文依据；数值与适用人群以引文为准。

【Abstract · abstract-1-3】Our approach achieved reasonably accurate classification of Gleason scores (GS) 6(3 + 3) vs. ≥7 and 7(3 + 4) vs. 7(4 + 3) despite the presence of highly unbalanced samples by using two different sample augmentation techniques followed by feature selection-based classification.

【Abstract · abstract-1-4】Our method distinguished between GS 6(3 + 3) and ≥7 cancers with 93% accuracy for cancers occurring in both peripheral (PZ) and transition (TZ) zones and 92% for cancers occurring in the PZ alone.

evidence.text: Our approach achieved reasonably accurate classification of Gleason scores (GS) 6(3 + 3) vs. ≥7 and 7(3 + 4) vs. 7(4 + 3) despite the presence of highly unbalanced samples by using two different sample augmentation techniques followed by feature selection-based classification.
Our method distinguished between GS 6(3 + 3) and ≥7 cancers with 93% accuracy for cancers occurring in both peripheral (PZ) and transition (TZ) zones and 92% for cancers occurring in the PZ alone.
